alerts.title: Hypothyroidism Management
alerts.message: Guidelines emphasize proper management of hypothyroidism. Patient shows elevated TSH (12.4 mIU/L) and low free T4, indicating inadequate levothyroxine dose or non-adherence. Patient often forgets the thyroid tablet, suggesting adherence issues.

evidence.recommended_action: Adjust levothyroxine dose and emphasize adherence.

alerts.title: Weight Gain on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines mention weight gain as a potential side effect of DTG, though recent evidence suggests the association may not be causal. Patient experienced significant weight gain (9 kg over the past year) on TLD (DTG-based regimen).

evidence.recommended_action: Consider alternative regimens or enhanced monitoring.

alerts.title: Glucose Monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend checking glucose in patients with risk factors for hyperglycemia, including those on DTG. Patient has a fasting glucose of 5.6 mmol/L, which is within normal limits, but monitoring should continue due to age and BMI.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue glucose monitoring as part of routine care.
